notes.title: Available To Play!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040607/4286b73f0bebf89249f969eabcd88f3e40c5d56b.png[/img]

"Finally! Board Wars Trick-Or-Treat is now available to play, and just in time for spooky seasona. Now hurry, and bring me my candy!" - Big Boss

notes.title: Play Testing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040607/841c7ffe4384987f9d4bb663402bfac6dcb8c1aa.png[/img]

New Update! We are preparing to roll out test playing access. At this time, you may see the option to sign up on our home page. We will begin official play testing for the public at the end of the month. Please hold onto your candy buckets a little bit longer as our team continues to playtest the game. There are still some major bugs that are being sorted out. See you soon!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040607/ad3ef3b07565c199c8b05252c5d2c43fddaccc14.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040607/acfe3a48d7126c54d7b85b6f89dc21de496ee7f8.png[/img][/url]

Hey Trick or Treaters! I hope your not afraid of sharks. This week, we added our lake monster who is usually pretty friendly. But come Hallow's eve, he cant control his sweet tooth. If you explore the board enough, you just may unlock him. Who knows, maybe you can use him for your advantage...

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040607/54d02c1c6ebae3e663356af6258aa4f5ea861cc2.png[/img]

Hello Trick or Treaters! This week, we worked on implementing the gate mechanic. Unlock parts of the map at the expense of your own candy in hopes to increase your chance of winning! But beware, this too comes with risks...

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040607/c0f01c17c972970799e4e3c7c2be28a2e5a7d38b.png[/img]
